review_candidates.title: Industrial Engineer (P2)
review_candidates.description: About Analog Devices Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X. Job Description Summary Analog Devices is seeking an experienced Industrial Engineer to join the Central Industrial Engineering team. This role will lead high-impact initiatives focused on capacity modeling, factory scheduling, cycle time reduction, operations research, and productivity improvement across ADI's front-end manufacturing network. The successful candidate will drive development of cross-site analytical models, optimization tools, and data-driven decision systems that maximize factory output, support expansion planning, and establish standardized Industrial Engineering practices across multiple manufacturing sites. Responsibilities Lead development of cross-site capacity models, utilization analyses, loading scenarios, and expansion planning studies. Drive cycle time reduction and WIP optimization initiatives through Factory Physics methodologies, bottleneck analysis, and constraint management. Develop and maintain advanced analytical tools supporting factory scheduling, output optimization, and operational decision making. Perform operations research and statistical analyses to identify key output levers and productivity improvement opportunities. Design and implement predictive models, optimization algorithms, and AI-enabled analytical solutions for manufacturing applications. Lead validation and continuous improvement of scheduling logic, factory planning assumptions, and manufacturing data structures. Establish standard methodologies, governance processes, and best practices across multiple manufacturing sites. Mentor junior Industrial Engineers and provide technical leadership on analytical projects. Partner with site leadership, operations teams, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, and IT to drive strategic improvement initiatives. Present recommendations, scenario analyses, and business cases to management and senior leadership. Support development of long-range capacity plans and fab expansion scenarios. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related engineering discipline. Proficiency in SQL, Python, Power BI, and statistical analysis tools. Preferred Qualifications Master's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Data Science, Analytics, or related field. Semiconductor wafer fabrication experience. Experience with Factory Physics, cycle time engineering, capacity planning, production scheduling, or manufacturing optimization. Experience with simulation, optimization modeling, machine learning, or operations research techniques. Work Experience 3–5 years of Industrial Engineering experience in semiconductor manufacturing or other complex manufacturing environments. Experience building capacity models, productivity analyses, factory scheduling models, or optimization tools. Demonstrated success leading cross-functional improvement initiatives. Strong analytical, communication, and project leadership skills. Experience working with globally distributed teams is preferred. For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process. Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group. Job Req Type: Experienced Required Travel: Yes, 10% of the time Shift Type: 1st Shift/Days

Misión Gestionar y coordinar los procesos de movilidad internacional dentro de la organización, acompañando a las personas desplazadas y asegurando que las asignaciones internacionales se desarrollen de forma eficiente, cumpliendo con la normativa fiscal, laboral y migratoria, y alineadas con las necesidades del negocio. Participar en la elaboración y seguimiento del presupuesto anual de movilidad internacional. Realizar seguimiento de indicadores de movilidad y proponer mejoras y optimización de procesos. Participar en proyectos transversales relacionados con el desarrollo del talento internacional y la mejora de los procesos de movilidad. Participar en foros externos de expertos que permitan actualizar e integrar mejores prácticas o innovación en el proceso de movilidad internacional. Experiencia mínima de 8 años en departamentos de Movilidad Internacional en entornos multinacionales. Nivel alto de inglés (C1). Se valorará conocimiento de euskera. Experiencia trabajando en entornos internacionales, siendo especialmente valorable experiencia en países anglosajones (USA, Australia,...). Contrato indefinido. Entorno de trabajo internacional y dinámico. Horario flexible y facilidades para la conciliación laboral – personal. Retribución competitiva acorde a la experiencia aportada. Por ello, si reúnes los requisitos generales de la vacante y dispones de certificado con grado de discapacidad igual o superior al 33%, Ingeteam valorará positivamente tu candidatura.

The NVIDIA HW microarchitecture group is looking for an extraordinary Solution Architect to participate in helping our customers to get the maximum performance from our NVIDIA Network products. The successful candidate will show strong background in chip design (Arch, microArch, design, DV), excellent system view, ability to work independently, good communication and motivation to solve sophisticated problems. What You’ll Be Doing Help customers get the best performance from our products. Debug sophisticated customers issues. Come up with solutions for current and future products. Work with teams and customers from around the world. Partner closely with our field engineers and architecture. Proven experience debugging complex silicon or system issues in production or large-scale customer environments. Strong communication skills, including the ability to engage directly with senior technical stakeholders at major customers and explain intricate technical topics clearly. High level of ownership, autonomy, and the ability to drive issues and initiatives across multiple teams and time zones. Ways to stand out from the crowd Practical experience with networking or AI cluster performance optimization, including technologies such as RDMA, RoCE, InfiniBand, or large-scale Ethernet fabrics. Background in customer-facing solution, field, or escalation engineering for data center, cloud, or HPC environments. Expertise in buffer management, congestion control, or large distributed system performance tuning. Experience influencing product or architecture decisions based on field data and customer requirements. NVIDIA networking intelligent interconnect solutions increase data centre efficiency by providing the highest throughput and lowest latency, delivering data faster to applications and unlocking system performance. With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you! NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. , , JR2011672

review_candidates.title: Chief Executive Officer
review_candidates.description: MaidProvider.ph is appointing its first Chief Executive Officer. ABOUT MAIDPROVIDER.PH MaidProvider.ph is a DOLE-licensed household staffing agency established in 2009, operating under one name and one continuous DOLE licensing history since then. We place kasambahay and household professionals in Philippine homes through structured screening, matching and client support. Hiring for the home deserves care, judgment and accountability. That belief runs through everything we do. THE ROLE The founder has led the company for seventeen years and will remain Managing Director and principal shareholder. The Chief Executive Officer will take day-to-day leadership of the business and carry a ten-year mandate: to grow MaidProvider.ph from a single Manila base into the national reference point for household staffing in the Philippines. The opening of our second hub in Clark, Pampanga in 2027 will be the first milestone. This is an ownership role. EQUITY The Chief Executive Officer will receive an equity interest in MaidProvider.ph Corp., vesting over the ten-year mandate against performance milestones agreed with the board. WHAT YOU’LL DO • Own the company’s P&L, growth plan and operating rhythm • Lead and develop a team of 16+ across client acquisition, client care, recruitment, HR and operations • Open and scale new hubs, beginning with Clark • Build the systems, leadership bench and capital structure required by a multi-hub company • Protect the standard: DOLE compliance, worker protection and transparent reporting are conditions of the role, not variables WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR • Ten or more years of leadership experience, including at least five years running a company or business unit with full P&L responsibility • MBA or equivalent graduate business degree preferred • A record of scaling a service or people-intensive business, ideally in the Philippines • Fluency in English and Filipino, with the ability to work closely with a founder based between Manila and the United States • Judgment, discretion and a long horizon. This is a decade, not a rotation. DETAILS Full-time and on-site at our Pasay City hub. Compensation combines salary, performance incentives and an ownership component. Apply with your CV and a short note describing how you would approach the first two years. A formal cover letter is not required. Send applications to amanda@maidprovider.ph with “CEO” in the subject line. MaidProvider.ph Setting the standard since 2009.

Nomaban est immatriculée à l’ORIAS en France en qualité de COBSP (n° 26008422) et bénéficie en Afrique centrale de l’Avis de Non-Objection n° 000879 de la BEAC . 🌐 www.nomaban.com Description du poste En tant que Chargé(e) de Déploiement - Institutions financières , vous accompagnerez la mise en œuvre de la solution Nomaban auprès de banques, établissements de microfinance et autres institutions financières partenaires, depuis le cadrage jusqu’à la mise en production et au suivi des premières opérations. Vos principales missions : piloter les projets de déploiement de la solution ; coordonner les équipes métiers, opérations, conformité et IT ; recueillir et formaliser les besoins, contraintes et processus des partenaires ; coordonner les intégrations techniques, les tests et les phases de recette ; organiser la formation des utilisateurs et accompagner la mise en production ; suivre les premières opérations et contribuer à la résolution des points bloquants ; assurer le suivi post-déploiement et recueillir les retours des partenaires. Qualifications Bac+4/5 en banque, finance, gestion de projet, systèmes d’information ou équivalent ; première expérience en banque, fintech, paiement, conseil ou gestion de projet ; bonne compréhension des processus bancaires et des paiements internationaux ; capacité à travailler avec des équipes métiers, conformité, opérations et IT ; excellentes capacités d’organisation, de coordination et de communication ; rigueur, autonomie, sens du service et capacité à faire avancer plusieurs sujets simultanément ; une connaissance des API, du KYC/KYB, de l’AML/CFT ou des opérations de change est appréciée ; français courant et bon niveau d’anglais. Deux postes sont ouverts : un à Douala et un à Paris, en mode hybride. Type de contrat : CDI ou Freelance, selon profil.

What if your next career move could take you around the world? At Qatar Airways, being Cabin Crew is about more than serving passengers at 35,000 feet. It's about putting people first, meeting cultures head-on, and building a career with a truly global airline — one where the details you notice and the ownership you shape every journey you're part of. Put safety, security and passenger wellbeing first—every flight, every time. Support passengers throughout their journey, from boarding to arrival. Take ownership of the unexpected — handling it with confidence, professionalism and calm. Work alongside colleagues from diverse backgrounds and cultures, sharing knowledge to win together. Represent one of the world's leading airlines with pride, warmth and professionalism. Why Qatar Airways? Because your career shouldn't have to stay in one place. When you join Qatar Airways, you'll have the opportunity to: See the world while building an international career. Live in Doha with fully furnished accommodation. Explore career opportunities across Qatar Airways Group. Join a truly global team representing more than 160 nationalities. Qualification Is This You? Take pride in doing things properly and following through on what you say you'll do. Enjoy working with people from different cultures and backgrounds. Are in good health and physically fit. We've grown quickly, set records, and continually raised the bar for what's possible in aviation. We believe in taking on challenges, thinking bigger, and offering our people the opportunity to make an impact. Whether you're creating an unforgettable experience for a passenger or helping innovate behind the scenes, your contribution becomes part of our story. Qatar Airways was named ‘World's Best Airline’ for an unprecedented ninth time at Skytrax’s 2025 World Airline Awards.
